how: Isolated dev station on :9893 (disposable profile, seeded workspace) and one headless Chrome WITHOUT --hide-scrollbars, so the section scrollbar takes its real width (10px thin, measured). Shots at 1x pixel density, Andrew's look (custom hue 216, TEXT SIZE per shot). Staged page state only: stage.js (the main waits), stageA.js (one approval: wants to use fs read: notes/a.md), stageB.js (MISS FORTUNE's 23 builds, a group of five with a long title, NOVA's approval). probe = the earlier lane probe; probe2 = 6 s of heartbeats sampled every frame (rebuilds, keys painted vs the line read whole), each row's name line, and the panel's edges.

before_72b4ab4ff.note: Same station, same probe2, before the fix (HEAD 72b4ab4ff), stage A, 200px rail at STANDARD, default rails, crew rows 2.

1440x900.note: room 252px: the Approve once row fits, no scrollbar
